title: Sail Galveston Bay Charters
specs: Yacht Barefoot Babe is 53'2" LOA, very safe and stable with wide beam and heavy displacement
Yacht has two private staterooms each with private head and shower, climate controlled interior
Sailing includes options to anchor and swim, visit Boardwalk, or explore Double Bayou
Memorial burial at sea service with nautical certificate and optional photos or video
Children 12 and under must wear personal flotation devices while walking on deck
No glass containers allowed on board; canned or plastic bottles only for beer
No smoking of cigarettes, cigars, or pipes allowed on boat; vapes allowed
Day and sunset charters include up to four persons; romantic cruise for two persons
Burial at sea service allows maximum six guests
includes: Private use of yacht for you and your guests
Fuel, waste disposal, and vessel cleaning
gap: Exact prices for charters not stated
blurb: Guests enjoy private sailing charters on Galveston Bay aboard the yacht Barefoot Babe. Charters include day sails, sunset sails, full moon sails, and special memorial or event cruises. Guests may participate in sailing or relax, with options to anchor and swim or visit local stops.
extraNote: $50 deposit required to secure cruise, payable by phone with credit card · Deposit forfeited if cancelled 5 days or less prior to departure · If weather unsafe upon arrival, full refund or reschedule offered · All charters must be paid in full prior to departure · No glass containers allowed on board · Captain may end cruise without refund if guest intoxicated or unsafe · Meet at the boat in Kemah, Texas
